title: 43rd Annual CMH Auxiliary Bake Sale
seo_title: 43rd Annual CMH Auxiliary Bake Sale in Bolivar, MO
description: This bake sale lets visitors buy homemade baked goods, including sweet breads, yeast breads, cakes, pies, coffee cakes and candy, to support the CMH Auxiliary. Proceeds go to auxiliary special projects such as the Tremain Family Hospitality House, Carrie J. Babb Cancer Center, Citizens Memorial Hospital, Douglas Medical Center and CMH long-term care facilities. CMH employees and community members are invited on November 19, 2026 (Time TBD) at 1500 N Oakland Ave in Bolivar, MO.
